items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: But I definitely had good private instruction there, and Andy McGhee was another one, at Berklee.

ctx.x: But I definitely had good private instruction there, and Andy McGhee was another one, at Berklee. He was one of those old school, kick you in the tail type where if you weren’t prepared he’d tell you to leave and come back when you’ve got the whole chapter done. But yeah, I got a lot of instruction from other students as well. Like my friends that came from those arts high schools and then introduced me to a lot of music I’d never heard before. So there was a lot of hanging out and like listening to a million…
I want to take you back to the thing you said about being packed into a van and sleeping on the floor. I mean that sounds like my rock & roll days. I mean some things never change, right?
